title: Vallee and Davis six-level UAP paper

tellings.quote: jacquefully and eric davis put out a very nice paper of six levels of uap phenomena which range all the way from nuts and bolts at the bottom to spiritual or metaphysical aspects at the top

plain: The UFO researcher Jacques Vallée and the physicist Eric W. Davis wrote a paper setting out six levels of UAP, the official term for unidentified flying objects, running from solid machines at the bottom to spiritual or otherworldly sides at the top. Michels mentions the paper himself, without giving its date, praising it as a good way to sort the many faces of the phenomenon.
